assumptions: Revenue computed from all order_lines for the SKU without filtering by order status.
No adjustments for returns or cancellations; sum reflects gross line amounts.
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_cents),0) AS total_cents,
       COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM order_lines ol
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
WHERE p.sku = 'NC-BRG-08';
